refers.label: Refers to
refers.def: The text names, quotes or alludes to the other work. Computed from glosses whose target is a library work.

read.label: Read
read.def: An outside record shows the author read the other work before writing. Computed from encounters (B2).

rewrites.label: Rewrites
rewrites.def: Takes over the other work's plot, characters or scenes and changes them.

answers.label: Answers
answers.def: Different scenes, the same question, a different answer.

shares-form.label: Shares form with
shares-form.def: Inherits a narrative form or device, not content.
